name: EasyCoupon by KUWI
author: kuwisolutions

sections.description:
EasyCoupon connects your WooCommerce shop to your EasyCoupon account. You design campaigns and rules in the EasyCoupon admin (pop-ups, spin to win, goal bars, product-page offers). This plugin connects the shop with one click, adds the EasyCoupon script to your storefront, and applies a coupon code to the visitor’s cart when they choose to use it.

Once connected, the EasyCoupon admin opens right inside WooCommerce > EasyCoupon, signed in with your WordPress account, so you manage campaigns without leaving WordPress. You can also open it in a new tab.

Coupons are created in your shop as normal WooCommerce coupons through a WooCommerce REST API key that you approve when connecting. You can disconnect at any time from WooCommerce > EasyCoupon.

Requires WooCommerce and a shop on HTTPS. Compatible with HPOS and the cart and checkout blocks.

External services

This plugin connects to the EasyCoupon service (https://easycoupon.kuwi.hu), operated by KUWI Solutions. Nothing is sent before the shop owner presses Connect.

When you connect: your shop’s web address (URL), your shop time zone and a one-time random connection code are sent to the service; the service returns your account id and a plugin token that is stored in your database. While connecting, the service asks your shop (route /wp-json/easycoupon/v1/connect-check) whether the connection was started from this shop’s EasyCoupon page; it sends only a fingerprint (hash) of the connection code, and the shop answers only yes or no. WooCommerce then asks you to approve a WooCommerce REST API key (read/write) for the service. The service uses it to read your shop’s currency and language and your product and category names (for choosing which products a coupon applies to), to create and delete the coupons it issues, and to set up an order webhook. The key and the webhook secret are stored encrypted.

Order webhook: after connecting, WooCommerce sends every new order (including the customer’s billing details) to the service. Of each order the service keeps only the order id, total, currency, the EasyCoupon discount codes used and the amount they took off, and the random session id the plugin stored on the order (see below); orders with neither an EasyCoupon code nor a session id are not kept. This lets the service compare orders of visitors who saw an offer with orders of a small group who did not. If you have set up a coupon.redeemed webhook in EasyCoupon, the order’s billing e-mail is passed on in that webhook to the address you configured, and it is kept in the webhook delivery log for 30 days.

On every storefront page after connecting, the EasyCoupon script (loaded from the service) runs in the visitor’s browser and sends page and cart events (page type, product SKU, cart total and item count, coupon shown or used) together with a random session id to the service. The script also stores that session id in a first-party cookie (ec_sid, one year); at checkout the plugin copies it into hidden order meta (_ec_sid), which reaches the service with the order webhook. The script sends no names or e-mail addresses unless the visitor enters their e-mail in an EasyCoupon pop-up that asks for it.

The WooCommerce > EasyCoupon page, once connected, loads the EasyCoupon admin app from https://easycoupon.kuwi.hu in a frame. To sign you in, each time the page (or “Open in new tab”) is opened, the plugin sends the plugin token, your shop’s web address, and the WordPress user id, display name and language of the person viewing the page to the service, which returns a one-time sign-in code valid for two minutes.

When you disconnect or delete the plugin: the plugin token is sent once so the service can end the connection.

Terms of service: https://kuwi.hu/en/easycoupon/terms/
Privacy policy: https://kuwi.hu/en/easycoupon/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce, then EasyCoupon.
  2. Open WooCommerce > EasyCoupon and press Connect.
  3. Sign in to EasyCoupon in the new tab and approve the WooCommerce access request.
  4. Create your first campaign in EasyCoupon.
sections.faq:
Does it work without an EasyCoupon account?

No. Connecting creates or uses your EasyCoupon account. There is a free plan.

How do I remove it?

Press Disconnect on WooCommerce > EasyCoupon, then deactivate and delete the plugin. You can also delete the EasyCoupon key under WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Orders now carry the visitor’s EasyCoupon session, so the “What EasyCoupon earned you” report on the EasyCoupon dashboard can compare visitors who saw an offer with those who did not.

1.1.0

  • The EasyCoupon admin now opens inside WooCommerce > EasyCoupon, signed in with your WordPress account. “Open in new tab” opens it full size.

1.0.0

  • First release.
